root_cause: Build 335 company/treasury ledgers could retain protected document envelopes copied from canonical documents. Later authorization/presentation changes made those copies stale. The day-3/hour-83 compaction promoted old ledger rows into the audited archive, making GH_SAVE_SCHEMA/GH_DOCUMENT_PROOF verify the stale copy and raise document-proof-integrity.
resolution: Canonical legal documents keep their full document proof envelope.
Company and treasury ledgers store gh-ledger-projection-v1 projections with source proof/document provenance but no legal security envelope.
Strict idempotent migration converts only provably equivalent Build 335 legacy ledger copies and fails closed on material tampering.
The fault recorder is runtime-only and removed from persisted state while remaining available in .ghdiagnostic exports.
Diagnostics export proof forensics and state byte attribution.
